BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: What causes someone to have a heart attack? ASSISTANT:

heart attack is caused by a blockage in an artery of the heart that prevents blood from reaching the muscle of the heart. The most common cause of a heart attack is coronary artery disease. Other risk factors include smoking, high cholesterol, high blood pressure, diabetes, and increasing age.
